effectQuote: His swing didn’t even break her flesh!

holderQuote: Isceil was shouting at Beza, but she refused to retreat.
Beza, or Bezale, the Minotaur, folded her arms. She was fishing around in her bag of holding and now she produced a few scrolls. She eyed them.
The Hobgoblin hit her again, through her raised hands. Beza’s head snapped back. She roared and grabbed two scrolls on her belt.
effectQuote: The enchantments took hold as Numbtongue backed up.

holderQuote: Erin pointed at her, concentrating. Beza roared as she came at Erin. Pyrite tripped her. This time he leapt on her back and tried to twist her arm up, but Beza’s [Steel Body] made even that difficult.
